an9.21:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.
an9.21:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.
an9.21:2.1: tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi devā tāvatiṃsā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.
an9.21:2.3: dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena.
an9.21:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi devā tāvatiṃsā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.
an9.21:3.1: tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi jambudīpakā manussā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti deve ca tāvatiṃse.
an9.21:3.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi jambudīpakā manussā uttarakuruke ca manusse adhiggaṇhanti deve ca tāvatiṃseti. 22
